title: Bosun Realm 08: Embers Contract v1
description: Machine-readable delta schema contract for Embers (Realm 08), extending Archetype Catalog Dossier with realm-specific payload attributes.

exif_payload.description: Raw or normalized EXIF metadata payload from the media asset.

codec.description: Media codec or MIME container format (e.g., image/jpeg, video/mp4, h265).
